findings.desc: resolveHardBudget uses `env ?? {}` (empty object) instead of `env ?? process.env`, so when `opts.env` is `undefined` (the production path in lattice-dispatch.ts — `ledgerOpts` has no `env` key) the function sees `{}` and never finds `LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS` or `KOALA_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS` from the real process environment. The budget guard silently never fires in production. The smoke suite misses this because every test passes an explicit env object. Fix: change `const source = env ?? {};` to `const source = env ?? process.env;` in `resolveHardBudget`, or add `env: process.env` to `ledgerOpts` in `lattice-dispatch.ts`. File: packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts:518 (resolveHardBudget); cross-ref packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:1962 (ledgerOpts missing env key).
